title: Ponytail — The GitHub Skill That Makes AI Code Like A Lazy Senior Dev
description:
This free GitHub repo just hit 63,000+ stars — and it's a 
little controversial.

It's called Ponytail — and it changes the way AI thinks when coding.

Instead of building everything from scratch, Ponytail forces your 
AI agent to reason like the laziest senior developer in the room — 
the one who looks at fifty lines of code and replaces them with one. 

Here's how it works 👇

✅ First — asks "should this code even exist?" (YAGNI principle)
✅ Then — uses standard library before anything custom
✅ Then — uses native platform features over new dependencies
✅ Only then — writes minimum code that actually works

Result: 54% less code on average, up to 94% less on over-built features,
20% cheaper API costs, 27% faster task completion. 

Works with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and more.
63,800+ GitHub stars. MIT licensed. Completely free.
